name: Wien displacement law
principles: the wavelength of peak spectral radiance is inversely proportional to absolute temperature
follows from maximising the Planck distribution with respect to wavelength

formula.relation: peak-radiance wavelength as a function of absolute temperature

conventions: b = 2.897771955e-3 m K is the Wien displacement constant
lambda_max is the peak of spectral radiance per unit WAVELENGTH; the per-unit-frequency peak is a different wavelength
T is absolute temperature in kelvin, not celsius
expectedLimits: valid for an ideal blackbody; a real surface has wavelength-dependent emissivity

seriesConditions.basis: a wavelength is positive for any finite positive temperature

references: Wien, W. (1893). Eine neue Beziehung der Strahlung schwarzer Koerper zum zweiten Hauptsatz der Waermetheorie
CODATA 2022 recommended value of the Wien wavelength displacement law constant
